tool: Built-in Imagegen; one separately prompted illustration per word
stylePrompt: Use case: style-transfer. Create ONE Hangeul Valley vocabulary sprite from the supplied accepted farmer STYLE reference; retain the shared warm oak, cream, muted sage, denim, amber palette and chunky dark-brown outlines, but replace the subject as described. Only include people if the subject brief asks for them. Authentic SNES 16-bit pixel art, 48x48 logical pixel grid, broad clean color clusters, at most 24 colors; designed to read clearly when reduced to 48 pixels tall. Front orthographic 2D view, one centered isolated vignette, complete silhouettes and complete hands/legs where present, a small empty margin. Opaque perfectly flat #FF00FF magenta background, including all gaps, reserved ONLY for the background. No magenta or purple foreground. No text, letters, numbers, logos, floors, scenery, shadows, smooth curves, gradients, anti-aliasing, blur, dithering or tiny noisy details. Do not repeat the farmer's original idle pose unless specifically requested.

retained.notes: Existing subject and silhouette reviewed during TOPIK redesign.

entries.en: to be deserted, to have no custom; (of air) chilly
entries.brief: A closed-up empty market counter, a shopkeeper leaning sadly on one hand, unused baskets and one wind-blown leaf. The absence of customers must be obvious; no snow or ice pack.

entries.en: a search for a way forward
entries.brief: The farmer kneels over an unfolded trail map at a fork with three short paths, tracing a possible route with one finger and a tiny magnifying glass. Show searching for a practical way forward, not running.

entries.en: an entrance and exit, a gateway
entries.brief: An open pair of oak gate doors, one small person entering from the left and a different person leaving to the right. Two separate directional arrows, entrance and exit both clear.
Three different miniature destinations, a library, market stall and mountain hut, arranged as a triangle joined by a dotted route. Exactly three clearly distinct locations, no globe.

entries.en: to visit a place; to look for
entries.brief: A traveler with a small backpack arriving at an open shop doorway, one hand raised in greeting to its keeper. Show a person visiting a place, with the doorway as context, not an isolated house.

A customer and maker meeting face to face across a low counter, directly exchanging a small parcel hand to hand; both complete people and hands clearly visible. No screen, telephone or courier between them.
A green leaf turning pale with a white frosted edge beside a thermometer whose fluid has dropped low, and two large blue snowflakes. The transition into colder weather must read clearly.
A shopper holding a woven basket of vegetables and offering one coin to a shopkeeper's extended hand. Focus on the shopper making a purchase, not on age.
Three descending stacks of the same gold coin, high to low from left to right, with a large downward arrow above. Clear decreasing quantity; do not use a light bulb.

entries.en: to go through, to be by way of
entries.brief: A ribbon-like blue path visibly passes through the open arch of a small oak gateway and continues on the far side. One farmer walks under the arch, showing passage through a route.

entries.en: business conditions, how trade is going
entries.brief: A miniature market stall beside an oak chart board showing a business line that rises and dips; small coin stacks at its base. Show the state of trade, not a wallet.
A sturdy sapling growing upward from a visibly cracked but repaired coin-shaped pot, beside a simple U-shaped trend arrow going down then back up. Show recovery after a setback.
The farmer strains to push a heavily loaded wheelbarrow up a short wooden ramp, leaning forward with bent legs and two sweat drops. Show exertion and determination.
A tidy oak display shelf holding three different sale products: a sealed jar, folded cloth and a small boxed item with blank price tags. Goods for sale, no shipping scooter.
A close-up transaction: one hand pays a coin while the opposite hand passes a fresh loaf over a market counter. The exchange of payment for a product is central.
The farmer gazes longingly at a ripe peach on a small display stand, both hands reaching toward it, a peach-shaped thought bubble above. Clear desire for an object.

entries.en: to become more numerous — 많다 with the change ending -아/어지다
entries.brief: Two adjacent flowerpots connected by a forward arrow: the first contains one flower, the second contains a crowded cluster of five matching flowers. Increase in number, not in height.
One unfolded single article page on a clipboard with a rectangular picture, several simple dark paragraph bars and a small fountain pen. No actual writing; distinct from a folded newspaper.
A newspaper page with its thick top headline bar prominently framed by a magnifying glass; the small picture and body bars below are subdued. No real letters.
A teacher points with a stick to a simple seed-to-sprout drawing on an oak board while one seated learner listens. Explanation of how something works.

entries.en: to eat with the eyes — to enjoy food by looking at it
entries.brief: A delighted diner looks closely at a beautifully arranged colorful plate, eyes sparkling, both hands resting away from the food. The diner admires the appearance and is not eating.

entries.en: to taste with the ears — to enjoy food through its sounds
entries.brief: A diner cups one hand behind an ear toward a sizzling skillet of vegetables; two clear sound waves rise from the pan. Listening to the sound of cooking, no spoon near the mouth.
A cook lifts one small tasting spoon from a pot to their lips, eyes thoughtful, the other hand steadying the pot. Focus on tasting one bite.
A single wooden meal tray with a full rice bowl, soup bowl and two colorful side dishes. Substantial appetizing food rather than an empty plate.
Three solid wooden shapes with clean silhouettes: a circle, triangle and square, neatly arranged together. The geometry itself is the subject, not paint or food.
An old oil lantern and quill on the left, a compact electric lamp and modern phone on the right, joined by one small forward timeline arrow. A readable contrast between historical eras.
An open golden gate resting on a small white cloud, with a lavish platter of varied delicacies beyond it. A welcoming paradise of abundance, no people or religious figures.
An oak television whose screen clearly shows a cheerful cook in an apron holding a pan and stirring a pot. The screen content makes this specifically a cooking show.
A real ripe apple held in a hand in front of a simple monochrome outline drawing of an apple on a small page. Emphasize the solid actual object compared with its representation.
The farmer lifts a cloth off a little wooden stand to reveal a bright sunflower, using an open presenting palm toward the viewer. The act of showing is clear.
A relaxed farmer smiles with eyes closed while listening through large headphones, gently tapping one boot and holding a warm mug. Enjoyment of a pleasant moment.
Two fitted jigsaw pieces, one bearing a flower and the other a bee, connected snugly at their matching edges. A visible relationship between the two subjects.
A small open desk calendar with a consecutive cluster of several adjacent day squares highlighted in sage, beside a tiny current clock. A recent period, not just one marked day.
A plain small task card at left grows into a larger prominent card at right with a bright gold priority star, linked by a short expanding arrow. Importance becoming greater.

entries.en: colour cosmetics — makeup, as against skincare
entries.brief: An open makeup palette containing four bold color pans, a blush brush and one colored pencil, arranged compactly. Clearly color makeup, distinct from a standalone lipstick.
A woman applies blush to one cheek with a round brush while looking into a handheld mirror. Show the hand actively applying makeup and a complete calm face.

entries.en: to tend, to groom — used of looks and of gardens alike
entries.brief: The farmer carefully trims one healthy rounded potted shrub with pruning shears, catching a small clipped twig. Caring for and grooming something living.

entries.en: a spark — in a headline, short for 불티나다, to sell out fast
entries.brief: Several bright amber sparks leap from a small pair of glowing wood embers, with clear angular tails. Focus on individual flying sparks, not a newspaper or a large fire.

entries.en: looking after something; also being in charge of it
entries.brief: An organized worker sorts three folders into labeled-by-symbol slots while checking a small clipboard on an oak desk. Managing resources and keeping order; no real text.

entries.en: to grow, to stretch out — of a number, and of time too
entries.brief: A knitted scarf is being stretched gently between two hands, a measuring tape extending alongside it and a horizontal outward arrow. Becoming longer or extending.
A wilted potted plant with visibly dry soil beside a full watering can; a gardener reaches urgently for the can. A clear situation that needs action.
A thick wooden pie-chart disc divided into one very large sage segment and two tiny cream and amber segments. The dominant portion is unmistakable; no numbers or text.

entries.en: to be in charge of, to handle
entries.brief: A warehouse keeper holds a key ring and an assignment clipboard beside an open storage gate, confidently indicating where a crate belongs. The responsible person handling the task.
Three plainly dressed neutral human figures on three different levels of a small wooden podium, with a single modest badge on the highest figure. A social hierarchy, not a government building.
A curious farmer leans forward to inspect a tiny butterfly under a viewing glass, eyes wide and one finger pointing at it. Strong interest and focused attention.
A traveler in a straw sunhat and sunglasses, carrying a beach tote and rolled towel while holding a cold ice pop. One person escaping summer heat.
A large bright sun beside a thermometer with high red fluid, two rising heat waves and a small sweating face. Intense heat is the subject, not a parasol.
Two hands sweep scattered litter into a dustpan using a short broom. Show the motion of clearing rubbish away and a clean space behind the broom.
A transparent measuring jug partially filled with rice, broad graduation marks on its side and a scoop beside it. A visible measurable amount, without numerals.
Two opposing shields and spears before a short broken fortress wall, one torn pennant above. A symbolic non-graphic war scene with no injured people.

entries.en: a war with N — what a headline calls a problem it cannot solve
entries.brief: A determined cleaner confronts a towering unruly mound of rubbish with a broom held like a tool for battle. A figurative struggle against a persistent problem, not military war.
Two farmers with sober concerned faces examine a badly cracked supporting beam marked by a plain warning triangle. The problem is significant, with no comic smiles.
The farmer leans back pulling a stubborn deep-rooted turnip with both hands, boots braced and sweat on the brow. Persistent struggle, distinct from pushing a wheelbarrow.
The farmer plants a seed with a tiny ripe corn stalk shown in a thought bubble above; a short arrow links the planting to the imagined harvest. The future goal motivates the action.
A hot sun causes an ice cube to melt into a small puddle, with one clear arrow from heat to melting. A compact cause-and-result illustration.
One potted flower receives water by three different routes: a watering can, a small rain cloud and a cup. Three distinct ways reach the same goal.
A shopper with a wheeled basket is stopped by a broken plank across a narrow path, looking inconvenienced and lifting the basket awkwardly. Everyday obstruction, not illness.
A weary farmer carrying a heavy basket walks under a small rain cloud, shoulders hunched but moving forward. Personally experiencing a difficult situation.
A coin income stream divides into two branches: a larger branch enters a piggy bank and a smaller branch reaches a spending pouch. A small segmented ring makes the saved proportion clear.

entries.en: the bottom — of a figure, rock bottom
entries.brief: One lone coin rests at the very bottom of a deep transparent gauge with a low horizontal marker; an arrow ends flat along the base. A figure reaching rock bottom.
A red kite climbs sharply upward with a long hanging tail and a small rising arrow. An unmistakable upward movement, without money or a lamp.
Three leaves tumble downward from a short branch, the lowest leaf near the bottom, with one broad downward motion arrow. Falling rather than being low.
A farmer actively climbs three short oak steps, one boot planted on the higher tread and a basket held securely. A clear ascent.
A very low footstool next to a much taller chair; an amber bracket indicates the low stool's short height. The low object is central and fully visible.

entries.en: the young, as an age group
entries.brief: A small group of three youthful adults with different hairstyles, casual jackets and study bags, smiling together. Show an age group, not a single shoe.
One fresh-faced young adult in casual denim holding a basketball under one arm, with upright energetic posture and dark hair. Youth, distinct from the group illustration.
A person with folded arms turns their head away from an offered bright flower, eyes half closed and expression uninterested. Clear lack of interest without anger.
An oak waterwheel turns under an unbroken stream of water, with a complete circular motion arrow. Ongoing action with no stop.
A small measuring gauge shows a pointer hovering within a broad highlighted band between two marks, with a soft wavy bracket indicating an approximate range. No numerals.
An hourglass stands beside a small oven containing a loaf still baking; the sand is halfway through. An activity requiring elapsed time.

entries.en: to come out, to show up — of a figure or a result
entries.brief: A bright star emerges into view from an opening wooden box, with the lid lifted and two short reveal rays. The moment something appears.

entries.en: for the first time in N — measured from the last time it happened
entries.brief: A strip of several blank calendar days leads to one final square bearing a newly blooming flower, with a long gap bracket ending at that bloom. An event occurring after a measured interval.

entries.en: throughout N, for the whole of N
entries.brief: A fisherman patiently holds the same fishing rod beneath a small arc connecting a sun to a moon. The activity spans the entire indicated time period.

entries.en: including N, and N first among them
entries.brief: One large gold star and three smaller differently shaped badges all enclosed within one rope circle; the large star is clearly the leading member of the included group. No lettering.
Three joined calendar leaves each carry a sun motif, with a tiny watermelon slice across their base. A seasonal span of months, not one beach object.
A wide sunhat rests beside a juicy watermelon wedge and a small icy drink under a warm sun. A compact summer still life, distinct from holidaymaker and calendar images.
A closed oak storage cabinet with glass doors reveals neatly stacked jars, folded cloth and two sealed boxes. Organized safekeeping without a person.
Two hands actively slide a sealed jar onto a tidy cupboard shelf, with an open door at the side. The action of storing something.
A refrigerator door is fully open, showing shelves with milk, eggs and vegetables; a small inward pointer highlights the interior space. The inside is the focus.
A hand lowers a red wooden block into an open square box, with a short downward arrow crossing the rim. Clearly putting an object in.
One blindfolded farmer calmly takes a companion's guiding hand across a short safe wooden plank. The guide supports them steadily; no danger or injury.

entries.en: a fiasco — a plan that lets you down at the worst moment
entries.brief: A baker looks dismayed at a completely collapsed cake in its baking pan, both hands open in disbelief. A plan going badly wrong at the crucial moment.

entries.en: to be at ease about something
entries.brief: A farmer exhales in relief with one hand over the chest after finding a lost key in the other hand. Relaxed shoulders and a calm smile, no heart icon.
A wooden tray of five eggs, each one individually bearing a small green check symbol. Every member is included with none left unchecked.
One striking golden flower stands among three smaller plain cream daisies, clearly exceptional in form and glow-free color. The special member stands out.

entries.en: to get hold of, to arrange for
entries.brief: A person opens a compact preparation kit containing a water flask, folded blanket and tools, carefully arranging everything for use. Getting necessary supplies ready.
A person hesitates before stepping onto a visibly broken stool while a companion raises a cautionary palm. A small red cross beside the stool signals the poor idea.

entries.en: N only, N and nothing besides
entries.brief: A serving tray with exactly one red apple in its only occupied bowl; a hand pushes the separate pear and bread plates away. Emphasize choosing only one thing, not a mixed feast.

entries.en: if you go on doing it, and what follows is bad — 믿어서는, if you go on trusting only that
entries.brief: A farmer continues pouring water into an already overflowing flowerpot; drooping leaves and a spill show the bad consequence. A single circular continuation arrow above the watering hand.

entries.en: the one you were in the middle of
entries.brief: A half-knitted cream scarf still attached to its yarn ball and two resting needles, with one translucent memory bubble around the unfinished work. The activity was left halfway through.
A cyclist fastening the open buckle of a required protective helmet before riding, a firm green check beside the closing buckle. Show an obligation being fulfilled, not a prohibition sign.
A small person tries to lift a huge oak barrel but cannot budge it; feet braced, barrel firmly on the ground, one crossed-out upward arrow. No injury.
A would-be gardener holds a thought bubble of ripe carrots while reaching first for a seed packet and trowel. A required preparation for an intended goal.
An oak public notice board with a simple recycling-bin diagram and a sealed official document pinned beside it; a civic rule communicated visually without any letters or numbers.
An official hand stamps a cream document bearing a small house drawing and a balance-scale emblem. The house and policy seal are the focal points, not a generic apartment.
An ordinary adult in a sage jacket drops a plain ballot into a wooden civic ballot box, standing upright with a calm expression; no party symbols, logos or text.
A thoughtful reviewer compares two ceramic bowls on a counter and marks a green check beside the intact bowl on a clipboard. Show careful assessment rather than shopping.
A miniature oak house resting on one pan of a balance scale with a stack of gold coins on the other. Clearly connect a home to its monetary value.
A giant upward arrow rising behind a small house is held down by a sturdy hand pressing it to a horizontal limit bar. Control of rising home prices, without a physical leash on a person.
A delivery worker in a plain cap and an apron-wearing cook walk home together carrying modest lunch boxes; friendly ordinary working adults with distinct complete silhouettes.

entries.en: the household economy of ordinary people
entries.brief: A parent at a small kitchen table divides a few coins between a grocery basket, a light bulb and a miniature home. Household budgeting, not an abstract stock chart.
A compact triangular circulation diagram: a small workshop sends a crate to a shop, the shop passes coins to a worker, the worker returns to the workshop. Three large legible nodes.
A shopping basket with bread, milk and vegetables stands beside a noticeably high coin stack and a small rising arrow. Everyday prices rather than luxury products.

entries.en: a harmful effect — and it comes with 미치다: 악영향을 미치다, to have a bad effect on
entries.brief: An oil drip from a damaged container lands on a formerly green leaf and turns its tip brown, with a clear short cause arrow. One readable harmful consequence, no violence.
A hand tips the first of three large wooden dominoes; the middle domino is falling toward the last. Clear cause spreading from one thing to another.
A clear drinking glass filled with pale blue water and three large ice cubes; two cold condensation droplets on its sides, dark oak outline, no person.

entries.en: to pour cold water on it — to spoil something that was going well
entries.brief: A joyful pair celebrating a small sprout sees their festive pennant droop as a literal splash of cold water falls on the pennant; faces turn disappointed. Convey dampened enthusiasm without harming anyone.

entries.en: to catch; to get something under control
entries.brief: The farmer catches a bouncing red ball securely between two open hands, with a short curved motion trail ending at the ball. Show grasping rather than throwing.

A composed adult calmly steadies a wobbling cup while others are absent; an orderly balance symbol in a small thought bubble contrasts with two motion marks beside the cup. Calm judgment, no ice on a head.
The farmer smiles with closed eyes as a broad pale-blue breeze from an open window lifts the hat ribbon; relaxed shoulders and one cool droplet. A refreshing sensation, not shivering.
A waist-up person rests one open palm on their chest, with a warm amber glow beneath the palm and a thoughtful gentle expression. Inner feelings, not an isolated red heart.
An enormous ripe strawberry beside a delighted farmer stretching both arms wide to emphasize its size. Intensify the quality with two bold emphasis rays, no numbers or words.
A deep wooden scoop overflowing with many clearly separate grains into a large heap; plenty in one existing pile, no before-after arrows.

entries.en: in the middle of doing it
entries.brief: A carpenter is actively painting an oak panel: half sage paint, half bare wood, brush visibly touching the boundary. Work in progress at this moment.
A rain cloud pours on a wooden picnic table and a nearby folded picnic basket is being carried back indoors. Show rain causing cancellation, as one compact isolated scene.

entries.en: to make something turn out that way
entries.brief: An adult turns a small watering can toward a thirsty potted sprout; the watered side becomes upright and green. The person visibly causes a change in the plant.

entries.en: the -ing form, turning a verb into something a headline can name — 잡기, the catching of it
entries.brief: A small framed picture on an oak easel contains two hands catching a ball, and a pointing hand indicates the whole framed activity. Treat an action as one named concept, no letters.

entries.en: a pet dog — the word a paper uses, not 개
entries.brief: A friendly small brown dog with a sage collar sits pressed beside its seated owner, who gently strokes its head; clear companionship, distinct from a dog standing alone.
An adult holds house keys in one hand and the handle of their own tidy tool chest in the other, looking responsible and confident. Ownership shown by possession.

entries.en: to keep, to raise an animal
entries.brief: A kneeling caretaker pours kibble from a small scoop into a puppy bowl while the puppy waits nearby. Show caring for and raising an animal, no generic paw print.
A close view of a playful dog gently gripping a knotted rope toy between its teeth while tugging backward. Emphasize the mouth performing a bite; no human injury.

entries.en: to get bitten — the passive of 물다
entries.brief: A single large tan rubber dog chew toy shaped like a bone, with two clear rounded tooth impressions pressed into its soft surface and one small dog-tooth pictogram in a cream pointer bubble aimed at those dents. The object is the recipient of a bite. Only an inanimate toy; no human, animal, body part, skin, blood, injury or pain. Chunky friendly toy-shop illustration.
entries.generationNote: Original mosquito-on-forearm scene rejected by Imagegen safety system; replaced with an inanimate chew toy bearing tooth impressions.

entries.en: a characteristic, what something is like by nature
entries.brief: A striped orange cat and a plain cream cat sit side by side; a magnifying glass enlarges the distinctive stripes on the orange tail. Show a defining feature.

entries.en: a thing people are sure of and wrong about
entries.brief: A person confidently reaches for a realistic red apple on a framed painting, then notices their hand touching the flat frame; a small surprise spark makes the mistaken impression clear.
Four identical simple cream cups sit in a neat row on an oak shelf, with another matching cup in a hand. Familiar repeated everyday objects, no arrows or rare ornament.
A confident farmer plants a boot firmly on a sturdy stepping stone and gives a decisive thumbs-up; a solid green check in a thought bubble indicates certainty.

entries.en: to be mistaken, to be wrong
entries.brief: A carpenter compares a badly crooked stool to a straight ruler, with an amber warning mark beside the tilted seat. Clearly a mistaken result, no broken human limbs.

entries.en: to look into it, to find out
entries.brief: A researcher leans over an open reference book with a large magnifying glass and a small leaf specimen on the page. Seeking information carefully, not reading for leisure.
One person points with a bent thumb directly at their own chest while their other hand rests at their side; whole head and torso, no duplicate person or mirror.
Three friends stand shoulder to shoulder, each resting one hand on the same small house model in front of them. Shared belonging to their group.
One ordinary adult in a cream shirt and sage trousers stands naturally with arms at their sides, full head-to-toe silhouette, no job props, icons or farmer hat.

entries.en: to increase — the plain one, of counts and amounts
entries.brief: A glass measuring jug receives more water from a pitcher; the water surface rises with a small upward arrow alongside the jug. Increasing amount, distinct from growing plants or coin charts.
A hand stamps one clear round impression on an otherwise empty cream card, with the stamp lifted immediately above it. Exactly one completed action and one mark.
The farmer rolls the same red hoop back along its starting path, indicated by one broad return arrow; a familiar repeated attempt, not a stack of copies.

entries.en: the short negative — 안 물어요 = doesn’t bite, said out loud
entries.brief: A person at a dining table gently waves away offered broccoli with one open palm, mouth closed and plate untouched. A simple immediate refusal of an action, no lettering.

entries.en: the long negative, the one papers write — 오르지 않고, 물지 않는다
entries.brief: An empty watering can rests beside a still-dry pot while a caretaker deliberately folds their arms; a small red diagonal across a water droplet shows the action is not performed.

entries.en: to say that — and with 확신하다, to be sure that
entries.brief: One adult tells another about a tiny sprouting seed shown inside a speech bubble; the listener watches attentively. Indirect reporting of information, no written words.

entries.en: before doing it — 키우기 전에, before you get one
entries.brief: Hands wash under a faucet while a clean meal waits on a separate little plate to the right, joined by one forward arrow. Washing precedes eating, both actions distinct.
Two people discuss a single potted sunflower centered between them; two empty speech bubbles curve toward that flower as their shared topic. No book or decorative badge.
A traveler opens a small memory album showing their own earlier mountain climb, with a tiny boot-print souvenir beside the page. A past experience that really happened.
A smiling child successfully balances on a simple two-wheel bicycle, both hands on the handlebar, with a small green check next to the front wheel. Ability demonstrated in action.
The farmer raises a spoonful of rice from a cream bowl into an open mouth; spoon, mouth and bowl form a clear action triangle. No merely displayed food or taste-testing expression.

entries.en: honey sleep — a deep, sweet night. No honey involved.
entries.brief: A contented sleeper curls under a soft sage quilt with relaxed closed eyes and a small crescent outside a rounded window. Sweet peaceful sleep, explicitly no honey or bees.
A person lies on their side in a simple bed, eyes shut and cheek on a pillow, with a single slow breath curl. The sleeping action, without a moon or dream bubble.

entries.en: sound sleep — the clinical word for the same thing
entries.brief: A sleeper rests completely still beneath a cream blanket, with a large calm crescent-shaped breathing wave and a bedside alarm remaining silent. Deep undisturbed rest, no medical diagnosis label.
A cozy sleeper has sunk deeply into an oversized soft pillow, shoulders relaxed; a single long smooth breath trail arcs across the entire pillow to emphasize thorough rest.
A seated person wrings both hands in their lap, shoulders tense and eyebrows raised, with one small tangled gray thought cloud overhead. Clear unease, no scary creature.
A wilted flower on the left and the same upright flower on the right are connected by a tiny watering drop and a forward arrow. Focus on the resulting visible improvement.
A tall friend steadies a small ladder while another friend safely reaches a shelf, both smiling; the supporting hands are prominent. Useful assistance in a concrete task.
A hand uses an eraser to remove a large dark smudge from cream paper, leaving a visibly clean patch and two crumbs. The unwanted thing disappears.
A simple clothed torso outline with a warm amber stomach shape visible through a small circular cutaway over the abdomen; educational and non-graphic, no full skeleton.
A seated person shifts awkwardly on a tiny hard stool, knees cramped and one hand supporting their lower back. Clear physical discomfort, complete body and stool.

entries.en: the word for melting quietly away — a headline quotes it and drops the verb
entries.brief: A small butter cube on a warm ceramic plate quietly softens into a smooth golden puddle, one corner still solid and one delicate heat curl. Gentle melting, no splashing.
Two friends carry one large woven harvest basket between them, each gripping an opposite handle and walking in step. Doing the same thing together.

entries.en: to let someone do it, to make it possible
entries.brief: An adult holds a gate open at child height while a child carrying a book passes through with a smile. Making an activity possible for someone else.

entries.en: not only that, but also — the written form of stacking with 도
entries.brief: An open lunch box offers a nourishing meal in the large compartment and an additional fresh apple in a second compartment, joined by a clear gold plus symbol. Two complementary benefits.

entries.en: only if you — a condition, not a recommendation
entries.brief: A hand inserts a key into a locked seed chest and the lid begins to open; a compact key-to-open-chest arrow emphasizes that the required condition unlocks the result.
As a person opens an umbrella, a few large raindrops begin to fall around it; the opening hand and rain occur together in one moment.

entries.en: it is a good idea to
entries.brief: A friendly gardener offers a sunhat to another person preparing to work in bright sunshine, a small green check beside the hat. A sensible recommendation rather than a command.

entries.en: N as well, on top of what was already said
entries.brief: A hand adds one ripe pear to a basket already holding a red apple, with a small plus between the pear and basket. One additional item alongside an existing one.
A compact oak storefront with two shelves of colored books visible through an open window and an open-book sign above the door. A retail bookshop, no large campus columns.

entries.en: the book trade — 가 as in 대학가, a whole scene rather than one shop
entries.brief: Three small book stalls form a short row, each displaying books, while one delivery trolley brings bundled books between them. A whole book-selling district rather than one shop.
A smiling adult and child joyfully hug beside a small blooming pot, open relaxed faces and two warm gold rays. Happiness as a lived feeling, no floating red heart.

entries.en: 'Happiness Train' — the name of the book, which is why it is in quotes
entries.brief: A single closed hardcover novel with a small cheerful cream passenger train illustrated on its sage cover; no legible title. It must read first as a book, not a real locomotive.
A seated reader holds an open book close enough that their eyes follow the page, one finger tracking a line; both shoes visible below a simple chair.

entries.en: to be enjoying great popularity — 인기 is popularity, 얻다 to obtain it
entries.brief: A short queue of excited readers eagerly reaches toward the same displayed book at a shop counter, with three large gold enthusiasm rays. Widespread demand rather than an isolated star.

entries.en: as many as a hundred thousand copies — 부 counts books, and 나 says the number is larger than you would expect
entries.brief: Tall orderly stacks of identical cream books fill a wooden shipping pallet, dwarfing one astonished bookseller with hands spread wide. Very many book copies, no numerals or lettering.
A shopper carries a newly purchased book away from a counter while the bookseller places the received coin into a till. Emphasize goods successfully leaving the seller.

entries.en: to be on sale — the formal word for the same thing
entries.brief: A front-facing bookstore display has several available book copies and hanging blank cream price tags, with one open palm presenting the stock. Availability for sale, not a discount badge.
A small cream train moves along a short rail segment between two tiny station posts, with a forward motion trail and one lit green signal. An operating transport service.

entries.en: the -앓이 ending: a craze for it. From 앓다, to be ill — but nobody is ill.
entries.brief: An enthusiastic fan hugs a favorite book tightly while a thought bubble shows the same cover surrounded by two bright rays. Intense fandom; no illness, bed or medical prop.
A fingertip presses the prominent center dot of a simple three-dot timeline, with only the middle dot glowing amber. The current instant, not a whole calendar.

entries.en: at present — the written form of 지금
entries.brief: A small oak status board shows one green active light beside a miniature working mill wheel, while two other lights are unlit. What is currently operating, no words.
A freshly opened envelope rests next to a calendar page that has just flipped backward once, with a short return arrow. Very recent past, not remote history.
A friendly adult presents a blank cream name badge pinned to a sage vest and points at it, with a small matching face portrait on the badge. No written name.
The farmer places the first seed into the first hole of an otherwise untouched planting tray, trowel ready and one small forward arrow. Beginning an activity.
A traveler with a small satchel strides away from an open house door toward a wooden destination post, body facing along a forward arrow. Going somewhere rather than exercising.
A large basket brims with numerous round red apples, several piled above the rim; no change arrow, no empty comparison basket. Existing plentiful count.

entries.en: in the space of one month — 새 is 사이, the gap between
entries.brief: A single calendar page frames a seedling at its top-left corner and ripe fruit at its bottom-right, joined by a curved route across the page. Change within one month, no numerals.
One large calendar page sits forward in an oak stand, with its entire date grid enclosed by a sage frame and a gold pointer selecting the whole page. No highlighted individual day.

entries.en: called N, going by the name N
entries.brief: A hand attaches a blank title label featuring a tiny train picture to a matching train-themed book. A name or title assigned to a thing, no letters or real book title.

entries.en: only up to — and the 만 is where the trap is
entries.brief: A toy cart rolls along a short segmented track that ends at a firm wooden stop; a forward arrow terminates exactly at the stop. An exclusive endpoint, not endless progress.
A small sun, cream cloud and blue raindrops cluster around a simple outdoor thermometer, arranged as one compact weather observation icon. Not only rain or only sunshine.

entries.en: to clear up — of weather after rain
entries.brief: A heavy gray rain cloud parts to reveal a broad golden sun; two final raindrops fall at the far left while the right side is clear. A transition after rain.
A golden sun rises just above a small open bedroom window beside a breakfast mug and a folded quilt. Morning before noon, no evening moon.

entries.en: I saw A, and then B — a change the speaker watched happen
entries.brief: A watcher peers through an open window at a gray rain cloud transforming along one short arrow into a bright sun. Show a personally witnessed change.

entries.en: even if it does — and what follows holds anyway
entries.brief: A determined gardener keeps watering sheltered seedlings while wind bends a nearby ribbon, protected by a sturdy apron. The intended activity continues even under adverse weather.

entries.en: and so, and then — the spoken form of -아/어서
entries.brief: A person finishes tying a parcel with twine and immediately lifts it by the same tied handle; a small forward arrow connects knot to carrying hand. A natural spoken sequence.
A person pushes aside a small toy car and chooses a bicycle helmet with the other hand, two branching arrows highlighting one selected alternative. Choosing one action instead of another.
The farmer droops on a low bench with slumped shoulders, half-closed eyes and work gloves hanging loosely from one hand. Fatigue without sleep or injury.
The farmer sits back beneath a small parasol with work boots stretched forward and a mug beside the chair. Awake, relaxed and taking a break.
A gardener arrives with a trowel while the sun is only a tiny sliver over a short window sill; an untouched breakfast tray waits nearby. Arriving ahead of the normal day.
A teacup is filled far beyond its rim and spills over as the pouring hand continues; an amber warning beside the overflow. Excess, not merely plenty.
A calendar page has exactly one square brightly circled in amber, with a small sun directly above that square and a hand pointing to it. A single current day.

entries.en: I really must — what you say to yourself when you decide
entries.brief: A sleepy student straightens their posture and firmly reaches for an open study book, a small clenched fist near the chest showing personal resolve. Self-directed decision.

entries.en: I should have — a regret, or a guess about someone else
entries.brief: A traveler stands in light rain holding an empty hand while a thought bubble shows the umbrella left at home; regretful expression and a short backward arrow.

entries.en: I saw that they did — reporting what you witnessed of someone else
entries.brief: An adult points toward a tiny scene inside a speech bubble where another person is watering flowers; a clear eye symbol joins observer and remembered event. Reporting what was witnessed.

entries.en: also does it, sometimes does it
entries.brief: A baker sets down a bread loaf and occasionally picks up a small guitar propped beside the counter; two discrete activity props, one relaxed person. A second activity they sometimes do.

entries.en: because — the reason you give before a decision or a suggestion
entries.brief: A person notices a gray rain cloud above the window and then reaches decisively for a closed umbrella by the door. An observed reason leading to a choice.

entries.en: to say "…" — 하고 keeps the words exactly as they were spoken
entries.brief: Two facing speakers have matching speech bubbles containing the same tiny red apple symbol; the second repeats the first bubble exactly. Direct quotation without any written words.

entries.en: someone preparing to enter the job market
entries.brief: A young adult in a tidy cream shirt reviews a plain resume with a small portrait, interview jacket hanging nearby and briefcase open at their feet. Preparing to seek employment.
A tall grain jar is filled to a bold horizontal minimum mark, with a small upward arrow continuing above the mark. The threshold and everything above it, no numbers.
A neatly dressed candidate sits across a small desk from one interviewer holding a clipboard; an open briefcase rests beside the candidate. Polite attentive conversation.
Two hands arrange a notebook, pencil and water bottle neatly in an open backpack before departure. Getting necessary things ready, not already leaving.
A person sits at a desk holding two different job offer envelopes, elbow on the table and brows furrowed, unable to choose. A single tangled thought curl between the options.

entries.en: owing to N — the formal twin of (으)로 인하여
entries.brief: A fallen tree branch blocks a small delivery cart at a closed road barrier; the driver studies the obstruction. A visible external cause of delay, no injuries or storm scene.

entries.en: depending on N, in line with N — a correlation, not a cause
entries.brief: A gardener gives a tiny water cup to a cactus and a larger cup to a leafy fern, side by side. The amount depends on the plant, with two clear matching arrows.
A determined traveler walks forward under a sturdy umbrella while a strong wind pushes three leaves the opposite way. Forward progress despite resistance.
An oak calendar stand has a short consecutive run of squares highlighted in amber, with an exam paper and two pencils in front. A bounded examination period, not a single day.
A focused student writes practice lines in an open notebook while checking a second textbook, pencil visibly touching the page. Show active study, no legible letters.
A school-age learner in a cream uniform shirt and sage vest stands holding two textbooks to the chest with a blue backpack over both shoulders. Full intact figure.
A compact quiet public library facade with broad oak doors, a large open-book emblem and book shelves visible through two windows. Distinct from the small retail bookshop.
A diligent learner studies at a small lamp-lit desk beneath a large crescent and three stars, with an almost-empty hourglass beside the books. Working throughout the night.
A hand pulls the cord of a tall cream floor lamp as its shade lights up with three amber rays. Turning on a light, distinct from pressing the wall switch illustration.

entries.en: do it and leave it that way
entries.brief: A person props an oak door open with a wedge and then steps away, leaving the door visibly open. The action leaves a continuing state.

entries.en: do it and leave it that way — the twin of -아/어 놓다
entries.brief: Hands fill two capped water bottles and put them neatly in an emergency supply basket for later use. Completed preparation kept available, not a door-opening scene.

entries.en: used to do it, again and again
entries.brief: An adult walks a familiar loop from their little house to a garden bed along three pairs of faded bootprints, with one looping arrow. A repeated past routine.

An ordinary adult carries a light box up two broad steps comfortably, with an unobstructed complete head-to-toe figure. Neutral everyday mobility, no crossed-out disability symbols or superiority cues.
A patient adult struggles to untangle a thick knot in a rope with both hands, frowning in concentration. A task with real difficulty, no generic warning badge.
A simple front-facing fully clothed human figure with arms slightly away from the torso and legs apart, each body region clearly visible. Neutral anatomy overview, no profession props.
A small bird nest sits on the very top of a tall narrow oak post, with an upward measuring arrow running along the post. Height clearly emphasized.
A curious person touches a real sprouting seedling while comparing it with a smaller matching sketch, then nods with a firm check. Confirming that something is actually true.
An amazed observer applauds a gardener holding an impressively enormous prize pumpkin, with two broad admiration rays. A remarkable achievement, no isolated trophy icon.

entries.en: it would surely be … and yet — a supposition with a contrast behind it
entries.brief: A person lifts a cooking-pot lid expecting a full meal shown in a thought bubble, but the actual pot is empty; uncertain disappointed expression. Expectation with an implied contrast.
A worried traveler wraps a treasured book in a protective cloth while imagining a rain cloud in a thought bubble. Precaution driven by fear of a possible event.

entries.en: since it will surely be … , so do this
entries.brief: A person points to an approaching rain cloud through a window and hands a friend an umbrella to take out. A confident prediction followed by advice.
A bundled traveler faces both falling snow and a sideways gust, visibly adding a scarf over an already warm coat. One condition stacked on another.

entries.en: to think that … ! — surprise or admiration
entries.brief: A surprised farmer leans back with open hands at a tiny seed that has produced a huge sunflower, mouth open and eyebrows raised. Astonishment at an unexpected fact.
A gardener plants a new sapling at the start of a short forward path leading to a small future orchard silhouette. A fresh commitment moving onward.
Three small clear jars show water levels rising in small equal increments from left to right, linked by two short arrows. Gradual change, not one sudden jump.

entries.en: to get warmer — 따뜻하다 with the change ending
entries.brief: A chunk of ice gradually melts beside a thermometer whose amber column rises, with a gentle small sun above. Increasing warmth, no snowflakes or shivering person.

entries.en: to change, to turn into something else
entries.brief: A simple green caterpillar on one leaf changes through a gold arrow into a warm amber butterfly with open wings. A clear transformation between different forms.

entries.en: the change carries on away from now, into the future
entries.brief: A present-day sapling grows along a rightward arrow into two larger future tree silhouettes, the farthest tree lightly outlined. Change continuing away from now.

entries.en: the change has been running from the past up to now
entries.brief: A faint seed and small sprout on the left lead through an arrow to a solid full leafy plant at the right, with the final plant emphasized. A process continuing from the past to now.
A cautious beginner tries playing one note on a small flute, fingers tentative and one questioning tilt of the head. A first experimental attempt, not a performance.

entries.en: to keep on doing it, more than one would like
entries.brief: A noisy woodpecker repeatedly taps a wooden post beside a reader covering one ear; three short tap marks emphasize bothersome repetition. No written sound effects.

entries.en: so that it happens — a purpose, and the two clauses may have different subjects
entries.brief: A parent angles a desk lamp toward a child reading an open book, carefully directing the light onto the page. One person acts so another can do something.

entries.en: so that — the everyday twin of -도록
entries.brief: A taller adult lowers a fruit basket to child height so a child can reach and pick a pear. Enabling a result through a concrete adjustment.

entries.en: if it happens, when it happens
entries.brief: A shopkeeper waits beside a counter, then reaches for a parcel when a small door bell rings, shown by a bell-to-hand arrow. Acting if or when a condition occurs.

entries.en: intending to — and the intender must be the one who acts
entries.brief: An angler deliberately packs a fishing rod and bait while imagining a fish in a small thought bubble. The same person prepares and intends to act.

entries.en: to the extent that, as much as
entries.brief: A wooden shelf bows visibly under a huge stack of books while a surprised person supports the middle with both palms. So much weight that a clear consequence follows.
An isolated bounded island map contains one mountain, a river and a tiny settlement with a plain sage flag. A whole country as territory, distinct from the Korean peninsula.
A child holds a tiny sapling while imagining a mature fruit tree inside a cloud-shaped window ahead, joined by a forward arrow. A hopeful future state.
An official cream document bearing a schoolhouse diagram receives an oak seal beside a stack of textbooks. Rules and planning for education, no real text.
Two identical clay lumps become two visibly different finished bowls in separate hands, one tall and one shallow. The outcomes turn out differently.
A plain-clothed apprentice pulls on a cream chef hat and apron, with a small old shirt silhouette behind a forward arrow. Becoming a new role.

entries.en: to depend on N, to rest on N
entries.brief: A small tabletop carrying a potted plant balances on one central sturdy support, with that support highlighted amber and a downward arrow pointing to it. The result rests on a key condition.
A compact year planner opens to twelve blank month blocks arranged three by four, all enclosed by one sage frame with an amber selector. The whole current year, no numerals.
A shallow woven basket holds a red apple, golden pear, purple grapes and one orange, each clearly distinct. A mixed fruit category rather than one fruit species.
A farmer counts three full harvest crates of matching apples beside a small fruit tree, with a simple tally board made only of dots. The quantity produced, not a factory building.
A gardener surveys four pots: three healthy green plants and one slightly wilted plant; a broad curved bracket embraces the whole group. A general overall judgment with an exception.

entries.en: to come down — of a price or a figure
entries.brief: A plain price tag hanging from an apple basket is lowered down a short vertical rail beside a shrinking gold coin stack. A falling price, distinct from a physical falling person.

entries.en: if it were to — a supposition, not a fact
entries.brief: A person imagines a small key opening a treasure box inside a cloud-shaped thought bubble, while the real closed box remains untouched below. A supposition, not an actual event.

entries.en: or it does … — offering one of several
entries.brief: An open travel bag sits below a forked path of two thought bubbles: one shows a mountain boot, the other a beach shell. Two offered possibilities, neither selected yet.

entries.en: perhaps because — a cause offered with a hedge on it
entries.brief: A person looks at a drooping potted plant and tentatively points to a nearly empty watering can, with a dotted cause arrow between them. An uncertain explanation, not a firm conclusion.

A simple cream-clothed torso has a small stomach-shaped cutaway glowing coral with two gentle irritation marks, and a concerned hand resting over the abdomen. Non-graphic educational symptom illustration.
A person in a simple sage hospital gown sits calmly on a clinic bed while holding a thermometer, with a folded blanket over the knees. A patient receiving care, no medical logo.

entries.en: to regulate, to keep something in check
entries.brief: A hand adjusts a large oak dial to the middle of a green safe range, with one small flow valve below responding. Keeping an amount under control, no numerals.

entries.en: to N — and it marks the person a causative acts on
entries.brief: A letter travels along a short curved arrow from a sending hand into the open hands of a smiling recipient, whose torso is emphasized. The person receiving, not the sending action.

entries.en: to come to be that way, with nobody making it happen
entries.brief: A wind-blown seed lands naturally in an empty flowerpot and grows into a small sprout, with no person planting it. A result arising without anyone deliberately causing it.

entries.en: to stand something upright in, to stick in
entries.brief: A hand carefully places a long-stemmed yellow flower upright into the narrow neck of a celadon vase, stem visibly crossing the opening. Inserting vertically, not just displaying a vase.

entries.en: to put something down and leave it
entries.brief: Two hands lower a closed cream book flat onto an oak desk, with one short downward arrow ending at the tabletop. Putting an object down and leaving it there.
A short branch has fresh green buds and three pale blossoms beside a tiny returning swallow; gentle warm colors, no full summer tree or snow.

entries.en: do it, then take it somewhere and do the next thing
entries.brief: A farmer carries a basket of freshly picked strawberries from a small plant to a waiting dessert plate, one strawberry being transferred by hand. Do something, take the result elsewhere and use it.
A humble traveler opens a lunch tin containing a single plain bread roll and shrugs gently, showing there is nothing besides it. A limited result, no extra fruit or plus sign.

entries.en: because it did — a formal, written cause
entries.brief: A walker examines a small map showing an already broken bridge and chooses the intact detour, a clear cause arrow from bridge drawing to new route. A factual past reason for an action.

entries.en: because of it — and what followed was unwelcome
entries.brief: A sudden gust flips an open umbrella inside out and blows a carefully arranged stack of papers from a startled person. An unwanted consequence from an unexpected cause.
A compact civic hall with a plain flag stands over an outlined territory map beside a closed constitution-like book with no writing. A state as an institution, not just geographic land.
A thoughtful person surveys a workbench with one spilled cup, a half-built stool and a waiting toolbox, hand at the chin. Assessing the current circumstances as a whole.
A recovering adult sets aside a walking cane and takes a comfortable step with a small green upward arrow, a light ankle wrap still visible. An improving condition, no before-after diagnosis chart.

entries.en: to be a shame, to be painful to watch
entries.brief: A concerned gardener clasps their hands while looking at a snapped sunflower stem beyond a small fence, sad eyebrows and a fallen petal. Regret at an unfortunate sight, no gore.

entries.en: it is only that, and nothing more
entries.brief: A worried friend waits outside a closed clinic door with hands clasped in quiet hope and a small warm thought glow. Only wishing or feeling, with nothing further they can do.

entries.en: it is only that — the twin of -(으)ㄹ 따름이다
entries.brief: A seated person quietly watches raindrops through a little window, hands resting still in their lap and no other activity. Doing only that and nothing more.

entries.en: it is to the extent that
entries.brief: An ice cream cone melts rapidly under a very strong small sun, with a surprised person holding a napkin beneath the drips. A degree so great that an observable consequence follows.

entries.en: there is no way it could be
entries.brief: A tiny teacup is compared with an enormous round pumpkin that cannot possibly fit inside, with a crossed-out inward arrow and astonished hands. A clearly impossible proposition.
An adult deliberately picks up a dropped wrapper beside a bin while another person watches approvingly. A visible considerate behavior rather than a static person portrait.

entries.en: to nurse someone, to look after them when ill
entries.brief: A caregiver gently adjusts a blanket around an ill person seated in bed and offers a cup of water. Warm attentive care, complete hands and calm faces, no medical labels.
One complete open human hand shown palm-forward with exactly five clearly separated fingers, a visible thumb and a short wrist. Warm skin palette and crisp dark-brown outline.

entries.en: to feel something — the active one, taking 을/를
entries.brief: A person closes their eyes while rubbing a soft cream cloth between two fingertips, focusing deliberately on its texture. Active sensing through touch.

entries.en: to be felt — the passive, taking 이/가
entries.brief: A seated person relaxes as a caring hand rests on their shoulder, a warm amber comfort glow arriving around the shoulder. A feeling received rather than an active touching gesture.

entries.en: try as you might to, you cannot — the same verb twice
entries.brief: A frustrated person tries to press a large square wooden block into a small round hole, bracing both hands; the block remains outside despite effort. Try as one might, the action is impossible.
A diligent person continues kneading dough even as flour spills onto their apron, calmly keeping both hands working. The main action holds despite an inconvenience.

entries.en: in the confusion of it — a cause, and a chaotic one
entries.brief: Several reaching hands jostle a small desk full of loose papers while one person tries to recover a fallen notebook. A chaotic surrounding situation causes the mishap.

entries.en: to seem to be doing it
entries.brief: A person tilts their head toward a closed kettle with a small steam curl escaping the lid, tentatively inferring it is boiling. Evidence suggests an ongoing action.

entries.en: to enter a school, to be admitted
entries.brief: A new student with a blue backpack steps through an open school gate holding a cream admission envelope, smiling toward the building. Entering school as a new member.
A student wearing a plain graduation cap holds a textbook beside a travel suitcase and a small globe with a curved travel route. Studying in another country, not tourism alone.

entries.en: day by day, more so every day
entries.brief: Three successive small sunrise discs arch above three matching plants of steadily increasing height, connected by short daily steps. Growth that increases every day.

entries.en: to increase — the formal word, used of figures
entries.brief: An oak presentation board holds three ascending sage bars and one clear upward gold trend arrow; a hand points to the latest highest bar. A formal increase in figures, no written numbers.

entries.en: in order to — the written twin of -기 위해서
entries.brief: A chef plans a future meal on a cream clipboard showing a pie sketch, then sets a mixing bowl beside it with a purposeful gesture. Deliberate intention expressed as a plan.
A painter finishes rinsing a brush in a water jar and hangs the now-clean brush on a peg, a forward arrow linking wash to hang. The first action is completed before the second.

entries.en: even if you try, it will get you nowhere
entries.brief: A person pours water into a bucket with a large obvious hole; every drop leaks immediately into a puddle and the bucket stays empty. Trying produces no useful result.
A slice of toast springs from a small toaster directly into a waiting hand, with a very short action arrow and two pop rays. An immediate response the instant something happens.

entries.en: whatever the task, no matter what it is
entries.brief: A willing helper rolls up both sleeves beside three distinct task tools: a broom, a wooden spoon and a wrench. Ready for whichever task is needed, no decorative question mark.
A cautious child wearing a safe swim float touches the edge of a shallow practice pool with one toe for the first time, an encouraging adult hand nearby. A new unfamiliar first experience.
A weary hiker with a heavy blue backpack leans forward on a walking stick while climbing two steep rock steps, sweat drop and bent knees. Sustained difficulty, not casual running.

entries.en: that is the way of things — it could not be otherwise
entries.brief: A rooster raises its head to crow as the sun rises behind a short fence post, linked by a small repeating cycle arrow. A regular natural pattern that is expected.

entries.en: it is bound to be — the twin of -(으)ㄴ/는 법이다
entries.brief: A very ripe apple bends its thin twig and starts falling into a waiting basket below, with one downward motion trail. A natural inevitable consequence.

entries.en: it is all right to, you may
entries.brief: A child holds a small kite while a supervising adult gives a clear welcoming open-palm permission gesture toward an open gate. Permission to do the activity, not an order.
An absorbed reader remains with a book while an untouched broom and empty watering can wait beside the chair; a small sun-to-moon arc suggests doing only that all day.

entries.en: it looks as though — an inference from what you can see
entries.brief: An observer notices muddy boots and a wet umbrella by a doorway, with a faint rain-cloud thought bubble inferred from those clues. A conclusion from visible evidence.
A friendly interviewer holds a clipboard with three large empty response circles while asking another adult a question; pencil poised, attentive expressions, no text.
A cheerful adult stretches both arms above their shoulders beside a small basket of fruit and a water bottle. Everyday wellbeing and healthy movement, no medicine advertisement.
An apron-wearing carpenter carefully planes a board on an oak workbench, hands firmly guiding the tool and two wood shavings curling away. Productive work in progress.

entries.en: a reply given to a survey
entries.brief: A close-up hand marks exactly one of three large response circles on a cream survey sheet held by another hand. Giving a survey answer, no letters or numbers.
Seven identical round counters arranged clearly as four sage counters and three cream counters inside one oak tray; the group of four is enclosed by a gold bracket. An unmistakable majority.
A small athlete jumps cleanly over a horizontal wooden marker, feet visibly above the marker with a short upward-and-over arrow. Passing beyond a threshold.
A closed reference book bears a simple leaf emblem; opening its cover reveals a matching larger leaf drawing with three small feature callouts. Content concerning a specific topic, no writing.

entries.en: for as long as it holds
entries.brief: A small lamp stays lit while its cord remains firmly plugged into a socket, the connection highlighted by a green enclosing bracket. The result continues while its condition holds.

entries.en: seeing that it was so, I …
entries.brief: A passerby notices an older adult drop a grocery bag and immediately bends down to help gather two fallen apples. A witnessed circumstance prompts a personal response.

A student calmly keeps practicing in an open notebook despite an intimidating stack of difficult books beside them, with a faint tall stack in a thought bubble. Perseverance even under a hypothetical difficulty.
A shopper imagines a full coin purse in a thought bubble but still faces a firmly closed shop shutter below. Even assuming the condition, the outcome remains unavailable.
A hopeful beginner holds a paintbrush while imagining themselves painting a sunflower on an easel in a thought bubble. Desire to perform an activity rather than desire for an object.
